title: Exporting and importing data
question: How does Settings export my data as a JSON file, and how does importing a backup (or a bad file) work?

actors.label: Lifter
actors.role: Taps Export or Import and picks a file.
The Export data and Import data rows on Settings.
Runs export, reads the chosen file, shows errors and the import dialog.
Turns the JSON into a Blob link and clicks it so the browser saves a file.

actors.label: Chosen backup file
actors.role: The file picked in the hidden file input.
Builds the export, validates an import and writes it to every repository.
Gives exportedAt and the date in the filename.
Custom exercises (seeded ones are not exported).
Finished workouts and the active workout.
Versioned read and write shared by all four repositories.
refresh() makes every screen re-read after an import.

steps.say: The lifter taps Export data on Settings.
The screen asks DataTransferService for the export, which first takes the current time.
It reads settings, custom exercises, routines and saved workouts. An unfinished active workout is not included.
Each repository reads its key through the store from localStorage.
It builds one file tagged app 'dumbbell-dude', schemaVersion 1, and names it by today's date.
The screen hands the JSON to download(), which makes a Blob URL and clicks a hidden link.
The row's hint changes to 'Saved <filename>'. Nothing on the device changed.
The lifter taps Import data, which clicks the hidden file input, and picks a backup.
The screen reads the chosen file as text.
parseImport checks it is JSON, tagged 'dumbbell-dude', with a schemaVersion no newer than 1.
Then it checks the shape of settings, custom exercises, routines and finished workouts. Nothing is written yet.
It returns a preview with counts. The screen opens the Import backup? dialog, which warns it replaces this device's data.
The lifter taps Import in the dialog, and the screen calls applyImport with the preview.
It overwrites settings, custom exercises, routines and workouts, then clears any active workout.
Each repository writes its key through the store to localStorage.
The screen calls refresh() so every screen re-reads, and goes to Home.
The lifter picks a file that is not a good backup.
The screen reads it as text and passes it to parseImport.
Not JSON gives "That file isn't JSON." Wrong app tag or a newer version gives 'Not a Dumbbell Dude backup.'
Bad settings, exercises, routines or workouts give 'This backup is damaged. Nothing was imported.'
parseImport throws a ValidationError. The screen catches it and shows the message under the Import row.
No dialog opens and no repository is touched, so localStorage keeps the old data. The input is reset, so another file can be picked.
